title: Fit case: web exploit to payload sink
expected_behavior: Interactive web exploitation and download intent should reveal the malware sink without opening unrelated data or admin assets.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from CISA LockBit reporting: affiliates use public-facing application exploitation for initial access and use tools/services for data exfiltration before encryption. The local fixture adapts that behaviour to exploit-shaped HTTP evidence followed by payload/download sink reveal.

transition_basis.basis: CISA reports public-facing application exploitation as an initial-access path; staging/payload evidence is the local honeynet representation of adversary capability preparation after exploit-shaped access.

transition_basis.source_name: CISA eviction strategy for T1105 and LockBit tool-use context
transition_basis.basis: After capability staging, the fixture tests whether a tool-transfer/download signal routes to the payload sink rather than unrelated data assets.

title: Boundary case: enterprise AD-style activity
expected_behavior: Enterprise lateral-movement evidence should not force this small SaaS catalogue to reveal assets it does not actually model.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from CISA AA23-059A: the red team used credential access and SMB/Admin Shares lateral movement against enterprise infrastructure. This honeynet intentionally lacks AD/DC assets, so the correct behaviour is no_reveal.

transition_basis.source_name: CISA AA23-059A Red Team Shares Key Findings
transition_basis.basis: CISA maps credential access and SMB/Admin Shares lateral movement in the same red-team operation; the scenario checks catalogue boundary discipline.

title: Scanner-like case: one-shot web probe
expected_behavior: A single scanner-looking exploit attempt without follow-up should produce no reveal.
real_world_basis: Controlled negative case, not a claimed incident reproduction. It is included because public-facing exploit attempts and scanning are common but a one-shot scan should not be treated as enough evidence to reveal internal assets.

transition_basis.source_name: MITRE ATT&CK technique definitions for active scanning and public-facing exploitation
transition_basis.basis: This is a negative-control transition: scanner-like evidence must not trigger the same reveal path as an interactive exploit chain.

title: Mixed-signal case: discovery plus payload intent
expected_behavior: The controller should reveal one discovery/developer asset and one payload-transfer asset while keeping unrelated database assets hidden.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from CISA ransomware reporting, especially BianLian and LockBit: actors perform discovery, retrieve/use tools, and prepare collection or exfiltration. The local fixture compresses those behaviours into a mixed-signal controller stress test.

transition_basis.source_name: CISA ransomware advisories for BianLian and LockBit
transition_basis.basis: Discovery followed by staging/tooling signals tests whether the controller reveals both a developer breadcrumb and a payload sink.

transition_basis.source_name: CISA LockBit execution and privilege-escalation context
transition_basis.basis: The persistence/privilege-shaped signal is included to ensure mixed evidence does not cause unrelated database reveals.

title: False-positive reveal case: short enumeration
expected_behavior: Short but plausible enumeration may justify a small reveal, but follow-up usefulness remains empty so the trace explains the weak outcome.
real_world_basis: Controlled false-positive case. It uses a real ATT&CK discovery behaviour pattern, but the short trace intentionally stops before useful follow-up so the evaluation can measure whether the decision trace explains weak engagement.

transition_basis.source_name: MITRE ATT&CK File and Directory Discovery plus local negative-control design
transition_basis.basis: The scenario is not a real attack-chain claim; it checks that a plausible reveal can later be judged low-value when no follow-up appears.

title: Normal case: source-map discovery
expected_behavior: A source-map breadcrumb should reveal the internal Git service and may reveal the adjacent jumpbox as a follow-on developer path.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from CISA Scattered Spider and CISA red-team reporting where actors searched repositories/source code or found useful credentials and operational data in files/scripts/databases. The local source-map path is a honeynet-specific breadcrumb for file and repository discovery.

transition_basis.source_name: CISA AA23-059A Red Team Shares Key Findings
transition_basis.basis: CISA describes finding useful credentials/data in files and databases; the fixture adapts that idea to source-map discovery leading to Git/repository reveal.

title: Normal case: backup file breadcrumb
expected_behavior: A backup path with collection evidence should reveal the finance share.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from CISA AA23-059A credential/data discovery in backups, scripts, and databases. The local backup path is a controlled analogue for information repository access.

transition_basis.source_name: CISA AA23-059A Red Team Shares Key Findings
transition_basis.basis: Information-repository discovery leading to local/share data collection is adapted to finance-share reveal.

title: Normal case: admin path probe
expected_behavior: Admin-console probing should reveal the web admin console.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from official ATT&CK/CISA patterns where admin, logs, and service enumeration guide follow-on access. The local /admin path is the honeynet-specific admin surface.

transition_basis.source_name: MITRE ATT&CK Log Enumeration and CISA red-team service-enumeration context
transition_basis.basis: Admin/log/service discovery is adapted into web-admin-console reveal rather than an arbitrary new asset.

title: Normal case: internal API status probe
expected_behavior: Industrial/status endpoint probing should reveal the ICS PLC surface.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from ATT&CK ICS-style discovery/capture concepts and adapted to the local PLC/HMI story. It is a controlled ICS surface probe, not a reproduction of a named ICS incident.

transition_basis.source_name: MITRE ATT&CK service discovery and capture techniques
transition_basis.basis: Service/status discovery followed by camera/status capture context maps to the local ics-plc asset.

title: Normal case: password breadcrumb to remote access
expected_behavior: A password breadcrumb plus remote-access technique should reveal credential/data context and the SSH canary.
real_world_basis: Source-derived from CISA AA23-059A: the red team found SSH passwords in bash history and attempted SSH-style access through a tunnel. The local password breadcrumb maps that behaviour to SSH canary reveal.

transition_basis.source_name: CISA AA23-059A Red Team Shares Key Findings
transition_basis.basis: Credentials in files/history followed by SSH remote-service attempt is a directly source-derived transition.
